name: model__prediction__generic__timesfm
description: Zero-shot time-series forecasting with Google TimesFM 2.5, a 200M-parameter foundation model applied without training or fine-tuning. Reads a parquet with exactly two columns - x (first) and y (second) - and forecasts y with point plus 10th/90th percentile predictions.

history_length.description: Number of rows to use as model context. Window ends at total_rows - prediction_offset. Minimum 3 (the model's minimum context). Values above 2048 use only the most recent 2048 rows.

prediction_length.description: Number of steps to forecast ahead.

prediction_offset.description: Rows to skip at the end before the history window. Use for back-testing against known data.

rules: history_length + prediction_offset must not exceed the number of rows of input.parquet.

episerve:inputs.description: One series: the time axis first, the values second. Column names are free and are kept in the output.

columns.description: Evenly spaced x values; the step is inferred from them and used to extrapolate the forecast's x values.
The series to forecast. Interior gaps are interpolated linearly, gaps at the ends are filled with the nearest value.

columns.name: x_auto_converted
columns.description: Only when the x column holds strings (e.g. ISO weeks): the step's row position.

episerve:documentation.method: Google TimesFM 2.5 (200M parameters), a decoder-only time-series foundation model, applied zero-shot on CPU. Context up to 2048 points.
episerve:documentation.intendedUse: Quick probabilistic baseline forecasts of a single epidemiological time series.
episerve:documentation.limitations: Univariate only: no covariates and no groups. The weights (about 800 MB) are downloaded from Hugging Face on the first run, so the container needs internet access.
episerve:documentation.trainingData: Not trained by EPISERVE; uses the published pretrained weights google/timesfm-2.5-200m-pytorch.
